item.title: Blair Oaks comes out strong after bye, posts 49-7 win against South Callaway | Jefferson City News-Tribune

WARDSVILLE — The Blair Oaks Falcons knocked off the rust.
The defense opened Friday night’s game with a stop, then the offense scored a touchdown. The defense got another stop, then the offense got another touchdown.
That back-and-forth trend continued well into the second half as the Falcons opened their postseason with a 49-7 victory against the South Callaway Bulldogs in the semifinals of the Class 2 District 5 Tournament at the Falcon Athletic Complex.

item.title: Helias rolls to 52-13 district semifinal win against Glendale | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description:

It’s a special teams play where the Crusaders send someone up the middle in an attempt to block an opposing punt.
On Friday night, “dagger” was the first of many daggers the Crusaders landed as Helias rolled to a 52-13 victory against the Glendale Falcons in a Class 5 District 5 semifinal at Ray Hentges Stadium.
